tools.name: get_options
tools.description: Lists every selectable option for a BandFactory silicone wristband: styles, sizes, fonts, suggested colours, flags, symbols, extras, the quantity price tiers, one-off fees and the delivery countries.

tools.name: get_price_quote
tools.description: Calculates the exact price for a silicone wristband configuration with the same calculation as the website and checkout (total, price per band, itemised fees, VAT or import charges for the delivery country) and returns the design link that opens the configurator on bandfactory.eu prefilled with this

tools.name: create_design_link
tools.description: Returns a link to the BandFactory configurator prefilled with the given wristband design, where the customer can preview it in 3D, upload a logo and order. Includes the total price.

tools.name: get_shop_info
tools.description: Shop details: product range, delivery countries and time, payment methods, proof approval, contact, terms and privacy policy.

tools.name: open_configurator
tools.description: Shows the interactive BandFactory wristband configurator with a rotatable 3D preview, prefilled with the given design (all fields optional).
